page: Microsoft Azure D1pds_v7 is an entry-level general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Dpdsv7 series, virtualized via Microsoft Hyper-V. The server features 1 dedicated vCPU built on the arm64 architecture accompanied by 4.0 GB of memory, preserving a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio. It operates without an integrated graphics processing unit and includes a bundled 59 GB local NVMe solid-state drive for high-speed scratch storage, alongside capability for Premium Storage volumes.

The instance relies on 64-bit ARM silicon, offering an efficient computing platform for cloud software built for ARM architectures. The single dedicated core provides predictable baseline compute execution, avoiding the CPU throttling or credit systems associated with burstable instances. The local 59 GB NVMe drive offers high-throughput temporary storage for operational caches and intermediate disk operations. However, with only one core and 4.0 GB of total memory, the system is strictly limited in parallelism and large-scale data handling.

Given its hardware specifications, the D1pds_v7 is suited for lightweight workloads such as microservices, small web servers, continuous integration agents for ARM targets, background worker processes, and staging or development environments.
description: Microsoft Azure D1pds_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine within the Dpdsv7 series, featuring 1 dedicated vCPU built on the arm64 architecture and 4.0 GB of system memory. Operating on Microsoft Hyper-V, this instance provides a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio alongside a bundled 59 GB local NVMe solid-state drive for low-latency temporary storage, with support for Premium Storage. The server does not contain a dedicated GPU and allocates zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The ARM-based architecture provides an efficient compute profile for cloud-native software compiled for 64-bit ARM platforms, while the single dedicated vCPU ensures consistent processing baseline performance without burst credits. Given its resource envelope of a single core and 4.0 GB of RAM, the D1pds_v7 is technically aligned with lightweight web services, small microservices, continuous integration build agents, and development or testing environments requiring local high-speed scratch storage.
